concern: Urdu لڑ پڑیں (lad paden -- to get into a fight, from parna/padna "to fall/happen") is romanised with a spurious h, "lad padhen", which reads like padhna (to read), a different common word.
suggestion: Aur agar musalmanon ki do jamaaten aapas mein lad paden to un mein mel-milaap kara diya karo.
